This convention equals an isotropic exponential decay length only for that shape; no exponential was fitted, no plateau removed, and this is not a domain radius. A plateau makes the integral grow with box size.

half_pump_correlations.phase_note: All exactly nonzero occupied amplitudes are included, without an amplitude or ratio floor. A phase of decaying seed/noise is not sustained order. Projected-sign walls are Z2 walls only when the phase histogram is bimodal.

template_summaries.correlation_filter: Whole late-record joint DC+Omega+2Omega amplitude, NOT the earlier16-cycle equal-time envelope

comparison_scope: Exact measured versus fitted reference F0 only; same fitted K/J and same bath/pump. Reused completed batch; not another simulation.
